description: National Water Supply and Drainage Board - Acquisition of Rattota Water Supply Scheme by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an order issued under Section 64(1) of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 2 of 1974. It contains a statutory instrument that embodies provisions of a voluntary transfer scheme approved under Section 63(1) of the same law, transferring water supply undertakings from Rattota Pradeshiya Sabha to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board. While it mentions Minister Vasudeva Nanayakkara, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than focusing on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content centers on legal authority, regulatory procedures, and implementation of existing legislation.
